title: Army (recruitable / fielded)
note: Roster of Warfare armies (reference/warfare.md). As a table it answers 'what unit is available / encountered'; as a reference the value carries type & level. Specialized armies unlock only after the PCs win over that faction in hexploration; basics are recruited via a Warfare/Statecraft Kingdom check.

entries.value: Basic Infantry — Lvl 1; melee line; cheap, sturdy, common
Basic Cavalry — Lvl 3; mobile shock; strong on open terrain
Basic Skirmishers — Lvl 5; ranged/harass; good in difficult terrain
Basic Siege Engines — Lvl 7; battering/artillery; slow, devastating vs fortifications
Sootscale Warriors — Lvl 3 (kobold; unlock via the Sootscales) — ambush & trap specialists
Lizardfolk Defenders — Lvl 5 (unlock via the lizardfolk village) — tough swamp defenders
Nomen Scouts — Lvl 8 (centaur; unlock via the Nomen) — fast mounted scouts
M'Botuu Frog Riders — Lvl 10 (boggard; unlock via M'Botuu) — amphibious cavalry
Greengripe Bombardiers — Lvl 7 (goblin; unlock) — alchemical ranged shock
Tiger Lord Berserkers — Lvl 12 (unlock via the Tiger Lords) — ferocious melee
Drelev Mercenaries — Lvl 9 (enemy/merc) — disciplined sellswords under Fort Drelev
Pitax Tournament Champions — Lvl 14 (enemy) — Irovetti's elite
Tiger Lord Cavalry / wild raiders — Lvl 13 (enemy) — the confederation in arms
